about: An online family tree app, based on the Gramps genealogy program.

prs.title: The relationship chart uses the symbols you picked
prs.broken: The relationship chart ignored the user's settings, so it always showed the star and cross symbols, even with text abbreviations chosen.
prs.changed: The chart now gets the app's settings, the same as the other family tree charts.
prs.matters: People who chose text abbreviations see them on every chart, not just some.

prs.title: The age at death column now matches the person page
prs.broken: The People list worked out age at death from the date text on its own, so it could differ from the person page and lost words like "about".
prs.changed: The column now shows the age the server calculates, such as "about 36 years".
prs.matters: A family tree shows the same age everywhere, with its uncertainty kept.
